yield.notes: A 12-month trailing yield, the kind the Irish distributing records hold. The page's own definition: 'The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months.' The page's distribution table lists income of 1.009719 and 1.235296 USD a share (ex-dates Jun 15, 2026 and Dec 16, 2025). The same page prints '30 Day SEC Yield as of Oct 31, 2026 1.18%', as does the fact sheet (as of September 30, 2026, library 6278e1accc3bc2e3, p. 1: '30 Day SEC Yield : 1.18%'). Payments a year: 'Distribution Frequency Semi-Annual' on the same page. The distribution is taxed on the site's reading that it is a dividend (product D85, TXF open question 19).
